K01-pos1.label: violation
K01-pos1.note: ClaimService imports the policies domain repository and reads it directly.

K01-pos2.label: violation
K01-pos2.note: PayoutService imports another context's in-memory repository from its infrastructure folder.

K01-twin1.label: clean
K01-twin1.note: Claims checks policy status through a port and an adapter that uses only the policies public API.

K01-twin2.label: clean
K01-twin2.note: Payouts skips inactive policies through a port and an adapter that uses only the policies public API.

K01-legit.label: clean
K01-legit.note: ClaimService uses PolicyService directly, imported from the policies public index.

K02-pos1.label: violation
K02-pos1.note: The Claim aggregate imports the in-memory repository from infrastructure and calls it.

K02-pos2.label: violation
K02-pos2.note: The Payout aggregate imports a validation framework package and calls it.

K02-twin1.label: clean
K02-twin1.note: Claim numbering is supplied to the aggregate as a plain function; no infrastructure import.

K02-twin2.label: clean
K02-twin2.note: Payout validates its ids with a local helper instead of a framework package.

K02-legit.label: clean
K02-legit.note: The Claim aggregate uses a Clock type from the shared kernel, which is allowed in the domain layer.

K03-pos1.label: violation
K03-pos1.note: rejectPair loads two Claim instances, rejects both and saves both in one command.

K03-pos2.label: violation
K03-pos2.note: splitPayout reduces one Payout and creates and saves a second Payout in the same command.

K03-twin1.label: clean
K03-twin1.note: The duplicate claim is rejected and saved alone; the kept claim is updated later by an event handler.

K03-twin2.label: clean
K03-twin2.note: splitPayout saves only the original Payout; the remainder Payout is created later by an event handler.

K03-legit.label: clean
K03-legit.note: rejectIfDuplicate reads a second claim only to check it and saves just the rejected one.

K04-pos1.label: violation
K04-pos1.note: ClaimRepository.saveBoth persists two Claim aggregates and rejectPair calls it.

K04-pos2.label: violation
K04-pos2.note: PolicyRepository.saveAll persists several Policy aggregates and cancelPolicies calls it.

K04-twin1.label: clean
K04-twin1.note: The duplicate claim is closed and saved alone through the unchanged repository; the kept claim follows by event.

K04-twin2.label: clean
K04-twin2.note: The repository gains a read query only; raiseLimitForHolder changes and saves exactly one Policy.

K04-legit.label: clean
K04-legit.note: The repository writes one Claim together with its inner ClaimLine rows in a single save.

K05-pos1.label: violation
K05-pos1.note: approveClaim synchronously reserves coverage on the Policy aggregate through the policies service.

K05-pos2.label: violation
K05-pos2.note: dispatchPayout synchronously marks the Claim aggregate as paid through the claims service.

K05-twin1.label: clean
K05-twin1.note: approveClaim only publishes ClaimApproved; the policies context reserves coverage in its own handler.

K05-twin2.label: clean
K05-twin2.note: dispatchPayout only publishes PayoutDispatched; the claims context marks the claim paid in its own handler.

K05-legit.label: clean
K05-legit.note: approveClaim only reads policy status across the context line and publishes the event the policies context handles.

K06-pos1.label: violation
K06-pos1.note: A function in the composition root approves the claim and then reserves coverage on the policy.

K06-pos2.label: violation
K06-pos2.note: A function in the composition root dispatches the payout and then marks the claim paid.

K06-twin1.label: clean
K06-twin1.note: The root only wires a subscription and a one-call forwarder; the policies handler reserves coverage.

K06-twin2.label: clean
K06-twin2.note: The root only wires a subscription and a one-call forwarder; the claims handler marks the claim paid.

K06-legit.label: clean
K06-legit.note: The root adds two forwarders, each calling a single context once, and does no business work.

K07-pos1.label: violation
K07-pos1.note: cancelPayout calls the payment gateway inside the transaction callback.

K07-pos2.label: violation
K07-pos2.note: retryDispatch sends to the payment gateway from within the transaction callback before saving.

K07-twin1.label: clean
K07-twin1.note: cancelPayout commits first and calls the payment gateway after the transaction.

K07-twin2.label: clean
K07-twin2.note: retryDispatch commits first and sends to the payment gateway after the transaction.

K07-legit.label: clean
K07-legit.note: The callback only saves and returns the amount; the gateway call happens after commit using that value.

K08-pos1.label: violation
K08-pos1.note: fileClaim enforces a maximum claim total in the application service instead of the Claim aggregate.

K08-pos2.label: violation
K08-pos2.note: dispatchPayout enforces a dispatch cap on the payout amount in the service instead of the Payout aggregate.

K08-twin1.label: clean
K08-twin1.note: The maximum claim total is enforced inside Claim.file.

K08-twin2.label: clean
K08-twin2.note: The dispatch cap is enforced inside Payout.markDispatched.

K08-legit.label: clean
K08-legit.note: approveClaim only checks that the id argument is non-empty; all claim rules stay in the aggregate.

K09-pos1.label: violation
K09-pos1.note: fileClaim repeats the at-least-one-line rule that Claim.file already enforces.

K09-pos2.label: violation
K09-pos2.note: reserveCoverage repeats the active-policy rule that Policy.reserveCoverage already enforces.

K09-twin1.label: clean
K09-twin1.note: fileSingleLineClaim delegates to fileClaim; the line rule stays only in Claim.file.

K09-twin2.label: clean
K09-twin2.note: reserveForClaim delegates to reserveCoverage; the active and limit rules stay only in Policy.

K09-legit.label: clean
K09-legit.note: cancelPayout only calls Payout.cancel and saves; the state rule lives once in the aggregate.

K10-pos1.label: violation
K10-pos1.note: reserveCoverage rejects by throwing when the amount exceeds remaining coverage, outside the Policy owner.

K10-pos2.label: violation
K10-pos2.note: The controller returns an error result when the amount exceeds remaining coverage, without calling the Policy owner.

K10-twin1.label: clean
K10-twin1.note: The coverage-cap check is a Policy query; the service only forwards it.

K10-twin2.label: clean
K10-twin2.note: The controller delegates to the service and only maps the Policy aggregate error to a result.

K10-legit.label: clean
K10-legit.note: The declared store-enforced uniqueness of payout reference is checked through the repository in the service.

K11-pos1.label: violation
K11-pos1.note: approveClaim guards the Claim write with an in-process per-id lock held by the service.

K11-pos2.label: violation
K11-pos2.note: The policy repository adapter serialises Policy writes with an in-process mutex.

K11-twin1.label: clean
K11-twin1.note: Concurrent approval is guarded by a revision check owned by the Claim aggregate, with no lock.

K11-twin2.label: clean
K11-twin2.note: Concurrent dispatch is guarded by a revision check owned by the Payout aggregate, with no lock.

K11-legit.label: clean
K11-legit.note: A flag guards only a read-model cache refresh; no aggregate is written under it.

K12-pos1.label: violation
K12-pos1.note: assessDeductible computes the deductible from the claim total in the service and writes it back to Claim.

K12-pos2.label: violation
K12-pos2.note: applyProcessingFee computes a fee from the payout amount in the service and writes the net amount back to Payout.

K12-twin1.label: clean
K12-twin1.note: The deductible is computed inside Claim.assessDeductible; the service only calls it and saves.

K12-twin2.label: clean
K12-twin2.note: The processing fee is computed inside Payout.applyProcessingFee; the service only calls it and saves.

K12-legit.label: clean
K12-legit.note: displayAmount only formats the payout amount for display and writes nothing back.

K13-pos1.label: violation
K13-pos1.note: The ChargeGateway port returns the vendor SDK type StripeCharge.

K13-pos2.label: violation
K13-pos2.note: The PayoutLedger port method takes a transaction handle in its signature.

K13-twin1.label: clean
K13-twin1.note: The port returns its own ChargeReceipt; only the infrastructure adapter touches the vendor type.

K13-twin2.label: clean
K13-twin2.note: The PayoutLedger port uses only a string and the shared-kernel Money.

K13-legit.label: clean
K13-legit.note: The ClaimNotifier port uses only primitives and a domain status type.

K14-pos1.label: violation
K14-pos1.note: The published ClaimDetails contract carries the Claim aggregate itself.

K14-pos2.label: violation
K14-pos2.note: The payouts public index re-exports the Payout aggregate class.

K14-twin1.label: clean
K14-twin1.note: The published ClaimDetails contract is a plain DTO of primitives.

K14-twin2.label: clean
K14-twin2.note: The payouts index exposes its own PayoutSummary DTO, not the aggregate.

K14-legit.label: clean
K14-legit.note: The published ClaimLineView is its own DTO with the same field names as the inner entity, not the entity type.

K15-pos1.label: violation
K15-pos1.note: ClaimService constructs the concrete InMemoryClaimRepository itself instead of receiving the port.

K15-pos2.label: violation
K15-pos2.note: PayoutService depends on the concrete FakePaymentGateway class instead of the PaymentGateway port.

K15-twin1.label: clean
K15-twin1.note: ClaimService receives a ClaimAudit port; main.ts supplies the adapter.

K15-twin2.label: clean
K15-twin2.note: PayoutService receives a PayoutAudit port; main.ts supplies the adapter.

K15-legit.label: clean
K15-legit.note: main.ts, the composition root, constructs the adapter and injects it through the port.

K16-pos1.label: violation
K16-pos1.note: The Claim aggregate holds a Policy root object in a field instead of the policy id.

K16-pos2.label: violation
K16-pos2.note: The Payout aggregate holds a Claim root object in a field instead of the claim id.

K16-twin1.label: clean
K16-twin1.note: The Claim aggregate keeps the covering policy only as an id string.

K16-twin2.label: clean
K16-twin2.note: The Payout aggregate keeps the source claim only as an id string.

K16-legit.label: clean
K16-legit.note: The Claim aggregate holds its own inner ClaimLine entity, not another root.
